title: The Post Correspondence Problem for free groups is undecidable
summary: We prove that the Post Correspondence Problem for finitely generated free groups is undecidable, even when one of the two homomorphisms is injective and has finite-index image. This resolves a longstanding open problem in algorithmic group theory. The proof proceeds through a connection with finite-state transducers. Given a cyclic tag system $\mathcal C$, we effectively construct a finite partial deterministic inverse transducer $\mathcal T_{\mathcal C}$ whose fixed-point set is nontrivial if and only if $\mathcal C$ halts.
